gate_interpretation: Prospective engineering stop limits, not calibrated equivalence bounds or a statistical test: <=1 cm endpoint and <=5 mm mean path difference for every round-tripped baseline. Three previously studied development states only. If any fails, finish baseline controls and stop before donor branches.
primary_measure: Within-state seed-averaged alternative-minus-same world-y contrast, separately for raw and round-tripped donors. Also report the paired change between these contrasts.
codec: Native eager temporal VAE at bf16; decoded RGB clamp [-1,1], full floating tensor with no uint8/JPEG; whole nine-frame encoding; original observed latent anchor restored exactly
review: AI-assisted exploratory visual codec review before donor execution; independent human review deferred. No new donor labels or matched-semantic claims.
limitations: Existing confounded whole-future donors. Survival through RGB does not erase language influence or prove human-readable semantics. Loss of effect may reflect codec corruption. No success-rate claim.
stopping_rule: One bounded pilot; no threshold relaxation, no donor search, no partial-run silent restart, no donor execution until all baseline gates and codec review pass.
